nodes.label: Model Merging
nodes.rationale: Technique merging parameters of multiple expert models without requiring original training data or expensive computation; enables knowledge fusion and transfer

nodes.label: Task Arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Basic merging method using task vectors (difference between fine-tuned and pre-trained model); enables MTL by adding vectors, forgetting by subtracting

nodes.label: TIES-Merging
nodes.rationale: Sparse subspace merging retaining top 20% parameters by magnitude; eliminates sign conflicts to reduce interference

nodes.label: DARE (Drop And REscale)
nodes.rationale: Sparsifies by parameter magnitude with rescaling; highlights importance of rescaling sparse models

nodes.label: Fisher-Merging
nodes.rationale: Weighted merging using Fisher information matrix to assess parameter importance; enables parameter-level weighting

nodes.label: Linear Mode Connectivity (LMC)
nodes.rationale: Property showing connected path between multiple local minima where loss remains nearly constant; justifies weight alignment before merging

nodes.label: Weight Re-basin or Alignment
nodes.rationale: Pre-merging method permuting weights to align models in same basin; uses techniques like activation matching, weight matching, or learnable alignment

nodes.label: Routing-Based Merging
nodes.rationale: Dynamic merging methods that adaptively combine models based on input samples during inference; includes MoE-style approaches

nodes.label: Human Preference Alignment for LLMs
nodes.rationale: Using model merging to achieve diverse human preferences without retraining; enables personalized and safer LLM outputs

nodes.label: Knowledge Unlearning via Model Merging
nodes.rationale: Using negated task vectors to remove copyrighted or harmful knowledge from LLMs without catastrophic forgetting of other knowledge

nodes.label: Multimodal Fusion via Model Merging
nodes.rationale: Merging modality-specific models to create unified multimodal model without expensive paired data collection

nodes.label: Model Merging in Continual Learning
nodes.rationale: Addressing catastrophic forgetting by merging models for old tasks with new task models; avoids parameter expansion and data replay

nodes.label: Model Merging in Multi-Task Learning
nodes.rationale: Merging independently trained task-specific models to enable single model performing multiple tasks simultaneously

nodes.label: Model Merging for Domain Generalization
nodes.rationale: Using weight averaging and model merging to improve generalization to unseen domains; SWAD identifies flatter minima

nodes.label: Model Merging in Federated Learning
nodes.rationale: Aggregating local models from clients while preserving privacy; extends beyond simple averaging to permutation-based alignment

nodes.label: Model Merging for Few-Shot Learning
nodes.rationale: Merging pre-trained LoRA/Adapter modules to improve transfer accuracy on unseen tasks with limited samples

nodes.label: Model Merging for Adversarial Defense
nodes.rationale: Using model merging to defend against poisoning attacks and backdoor injection; also enables IP protection

nodes.label: Model Merging in LLMs, MLLMs, and Beyond
nodes.author: Enneng Yang, Li Shen, Guibing Guo, Xingwei Wang, Xiaochun Cao, Jie Zhang, Dacheng Tao
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive survey on model merging techniques for combining multiple LLMs and MLLMs, covering methods, theories, applications and opportunities

nodes.label: Model Merging
nodes.rationale: Technique for combining weights or parameters from multiple trained models to create a unified model

nodes.label: Weight Averaging
nodes.rationale: Simple model merging technique that averages weights from multiple models

nodes.label: Task Arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Model merging approach using arithmetic operations on task vectors

nodes.label: LoRA Merging
nodes.rationale: Merging technique for Low-Rank Adaptation modules from multiple fine-tuned models

hyperedges.label: Model Merging Applications Across ML Subfields
